# Rivet

Rivet is an open-source, self-hosted PaaS for running Docker applications on a single VPS.
It provides automatic SSL, domain routing, encrypted secrets, auto-sleep, monitoring, and a web dashboard.

## Primary Links

- [Website](https://getrivet.app/)
- [Documentation](https://getrivet.app/docs.html)
- [Source code](https://github.com/devmin8/rivet)
- [README](https://github.com/devmin8/rivet#readme)
- [Sitemap](https://getrivet.app/sitemap.xml)
